theorems.name: Submission.adr_weak_tendsto_comp_affine
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n Q : ℕ) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q) (g : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (y : Euclid P) (mus : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (gs k) μH[(n : ℝ)]) → (∀ k, 0 < mus k) → Tendsto mus atTop (𝓝 1) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • gs k x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • g x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]))) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • gs k (y + mus k • x) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • g (y + x) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
